decisions.reason: As a recent launch that builds on the core range and is already backed by a public quantified customer-benefit claim, management is likely to stay committed rather than admit a failed investment.

Because it is close to the established offer and has its own dedicated presentation, the firm has made a visible commitment and will likely continue supporting it while results are still early and explainable as ramp-up effects.
Since this product line was presented as a flagship direction with several models, the firm is highly committed financially and publicly and is therefore especially unlikely to withdraw it soon.

Although the public commitment appears weaker than for the other launches, it is still a new product near the firm’s core business in a growing firm and industry, so management would more likely retain it than abandon it quickly.
